instruction.thesis: The PROMOTED_HYPOTHESIS long was entered on H-069 (BTC P/C ratio spike above 1.0 creating oversold bounce). The IBIT P/C ratio has since dropped sharply from 0.713 to 0.600 — a 15.8% decline — which represents the opposite of the spike condition that triggered the trade. Rather than a sustained P/C spike indicating excessive bearish options positioning, the ratio has normalized and moved toward bullish territory, suggesting the options exhaustion signal has resolved without the anticipated spot bounce materializing. BTC spot is at 76,899, down 0.12% from entry at 76,989, sitting at the 17th percentile of the 24h range and 2nd percentile of the 7d range — continued weakness with no bounce confirmation. The setup-family evidence (btc_spot declining, P/C ratio normalizing away from the trigger condition) indicates the thesis has not played out and the position should be closed to preserve capital for a cleaner re-entry.
